note: One run each. The memory value is a coarse sample of the resident size, not a bound.
probe: spawn the issuer with the compiled core; one valid request; 600 blocks of 1 MB with no line end; line end; one valid request; read the answers
what: One-off probe of the repair-check finding (issuer ended by one very long line with no end). A line of 600 MB of the letter "a" is written to the issuer with no line end; then the line end and one valid request. Scratch folder; not part of the EXIT script.
